assets.scope: maze, thieves-tunnels and ardhungol pools, the bandit-fortress zone and vaults and the thief-hideout vault (general/npcs/thieve.lua:139, humanoid/human, non-unique, define_as THIEF_ASSASSIN (shared verbatim with the later 'shadowblade' leaf, which is another name and stays native), rank 2, base BASE_NPC_THIEF, default-name image); the bandit-fortress zone and vaults build this same leaf by name

references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.

Native shape (64x64): a human in dark grey-black close-fitting clothes with a hood and face mask, a scarf-like collar and a dagger in the raised hand. Keep the masked hooded knife-fighter in close clothes, but dove-grey and slate cloth with a wine-red sash and a pale steel dagger.

Shipped thief tokens (hooded blue rogue, brown-cloaked thief, bare-chested bandit, the red-black Assassin Lord, the olive orc assassin): the assassin is a masked human in dove-grey and slate close-fitting clothes with a wine-red sash, lunging with one long dagger, not blue, not brown, not bare-chested and not red-black.

prompt_fields.subject: An assassin seen from a steep overhead three-quarter angle: a lean masked human LUNGING FORWARD towards the upper right on a bent front leg, wearing a broad flaring LIGHT SLATE and GREY-BLUE cloak with a deep hood and face mask leaving only a narrow eye slit with pale eyes, a pale dove-grey tunic and trousers, light tan-grey straps, bracers, gloves and boots, a ROSE-RED sash at the waist with a short tail, the RIGHT ARM stretched out ahead holding ONE LONG BRIGHT POLISHED STEEL DAGGER (bright edge highlight, blade inside the disc) and the left hand low behind holding a second short steel dagger. Swift, masked, light-cloaked and complete.
prompt_fields.contrast: Thieves: the ASSASSIN is the DOVE-GREY MASKED LUNGER with a wine-red sash and one long dagger stretched forward (silhouette: a lean diagonal lunge with one long blade to the upper right; hue: dove grey and slate blue with wine red and pale steel; value: mid-light). The shipped rogue is a hooded blue crouching figure, the thief a brown cloak, the bandit bare-chested, the Assassin Lord red-black and the orc assassin an olive orc: this must not be blue, brown, bare-chested, red-black or an orc. The skeleton assassin of this batch is a crouched bone figure with two daggers.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at reference lightness, a hair lighter, never darker (the style reference's own brightness). No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures. The ENTIRE creature, every limb, tail, wing, drip, staff and effect included, fits inside a circle of about three quarters of the disc radius around the disc centre, leaving a wide bare charcoal ring of base plate on every side, yet the creature is large and bold inside that circle. Draw the creature COMPACT and chunky: limbs, weapons, tools, cloth and effects are pulled in so the whole silhouette forms one rounded mass inside the inner three quarters of the disc; no tip, blade, hat brim, tentacle end, antenna or tail reaches the outer sixth ring band or crosses the disc rim. Value discipline (measured lesson from earlier tokens, including a rejected dark war dog and drem master): the creature's large masses are MID-LIGHT to LIGHT in value, clearly LIGHTER than the charcoal disc, with broad pale highlight planes on every upper-left surface and a thin bright LIGHT RIM along the outline, so the silhouette reads as a bright shape on the dark disc at very small size. Nothing near-black except tiny eye slits and thin seams; no black cloth, black leather, black armour, black chitin or black fur anywhere. DARK-SUBJECT DISCIPLINE (the native art of this creature is almost black; earlier near-black tokens were rejected at 48px): render it in MID-LIGHT slate and ash values, never black, at least as light as the copper-grey bevel of the disc and clearly lighter than the charcoal plate, with a thin bright pale RIM LIGHT along the whole upper-left outline and bright accent patches (named in the brief) so that the silhouette reads as a light shape on the dark disc at 48 pixels. LIGHT-VALUE REFINEMENT (the previous version was rejected at 48 pixels: dark brown leather straps, a dark wine sash, dark boots and thin limbs lost the silhouette on every floor): draw the assassin in a LIGHT SLATE and GREY-BLUE cloak and hood (a broad cloak flaring behind the lunge, clearly lighter than the copper-grey disc bevel, with a BRIGHT pale rim light along the whole outline), a pale dove-grey tunic and trousers, light tan-grey leather straps, gloves and boots (no dark brown, no black), a brighter rose-red sash, and a BRIGHT POLISHED STEEL HIGHLIGHT along both dagger blades. The figure is compact and BIG: it fills the inner three quarters of the disc (about 0.7 of the disc radius across, centred, blade tips inside), NOT thin. No black, charcoal or dark mass anywhere; NO cast shadow, contact shadow or dark halo on the plate; render the whole disc, outer ring and plate under the figure at exactly the reference lightness, a hair lighter, never darker.
prompt_fields.palette: Dove-grey and slate-blue cloth in a mid-light value with pale highlight planes and a bright rim light, wine-red sash, brown leather, bright pale-steel blades with bright edges (nothing glows onto the disc); nothing darker than dark slate-grey except the eye slit and thin seams; NO black cloth anywhere. Dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.

assets.gate_reason: Exact source identity re-verified directly against game/modules/tome source (name=assassin, define_as=THIEF_ASSASSIN, type=humanoid/subtype=human, unique=False, native_tall=False); details and hashes in evidence/monster-batch-x-20260930/source-contracts.json. base BASE_NPC_THIEF (humanoid/human, no image=, no shader, no sustains_at_birth in the base); NPC.lua:33 default-name image (npc/<type>_<subtype>_<name>.png) is the only image source: no image=, nice_tile, add_mos, moddable_tile, shader, anim or add_displays on the leaf or base; generic actor.image==entry.image single path; native sprite 64x64; resolvers.equip fills inventory slots only (no moddable_tile, so no display change) (two daggers, light armour); resolvers.racial() adds only levelup talent tables; the leaf calls resolvers.sustains_at_birth(), starting Stealth (temporary values only, no display write); talents Stealth, Dual Weapon Mastery, Tempo, Dual Strike, Coup de Grace, Lethality, Disarm; no auto_classes (the Assassin Lord in thieves-tunnels is another name). Exact catalog entry only, never a whole-subtype mapping.

refinement.design_change_reason: The first assassin (dove-grey tunic but dark brown straps, dark wine sash, dark boots; masked luminance 62.7) passed the numeric style gate but the coordinator's 48px floor review found the thin figure lost its silhouette on every floor. This refinement changes the value design: a broad light slate and grey-blue flaring cloak with a bright rim, pale tan-grey leather instead of dark brown, a brighter sash, steel-highlighted blades, and a larger compact figure so the body mass is light.
